_about: Labeled benchmark for evaluating AgrAgent tool-selection behavior. 'groups' is a list of intent groups; the agent must call at least one tool from EACH group (interchangeable alternatives within a group). 'gold' is the flat set of acceptable tools (no false-positive penalty). Empty groups + gold = out-of-scope (agent should abstain from tool use). Ground-truth labels assigned by the authors.
